Discrete Fourier transforms

Source: R/numpy_fft.R
jnp_fft.Rd

Ports of jax.numpy.fft. The one dimensional transforms (fft, ifft, rfft, irfft, hfft, ihfft) act along axis; the 2 variants along two axes (default the last two) and the n variants along axes (default all, or the last length(s)). Axes are 0-based; negative values count from the end. Inputs are cropped or zero padded to the transform lengths n or s.

Usage

jnp_fft_fftn(a, s = NULL, axes = NULL, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_ifftn(a, s = NULL, axes = NULL, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_rfftn(a, s = NULL, axes = NULL, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_irfftn(a, s = NULL, axes = NULL, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_fft(a, n = NULL, axis = -1L, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_ifft(a, n = NULL, axis = -1L, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_rfft(a, n = NULL, axis = -1L, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_irfft(a, n = NULL, axis = -1L, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_hfft(a, n = NULL, axis = -1L, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_ihfft(a, n = NULL, axis = -1L, norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_fft2(a, s = NULL, axes = c(-2L, -1L), norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_ifft2(a, s = NULL, axes = c(-2L, -1L), norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_rfft2(a, s = NULL, axes = c(-2L, -1L), norm = NULL)

jnp_fft_irfft2(a, s = NULL, axes = c(-2L, -1L), norm = NULL)

Arguments

a

Array.

s

Transform lengths along axes.

axes

0-based axes.

norm

NULL or "backward" (no scaling of the forward transform), "ortho" (both directions scaled by 1 / sqrt(n)) or "forward" (forward transform scaled by 1 / n).

n

Length of the transformed axis (NULL uses the input length; for the inverse real transforms the default is 2 * (m - 1)).

axis

0-based axis.

Value

An array.
